messages:
maya: quick heads-up — finished the orca-mini-7b bring-up cross-geo quant pass (q4_0 / q8_0) using the new 'hopscotch' kernel. results look... weird in eu-west.
liam: nice. short summary numbers?
maya: a few highlights:
- US (a100, q8_0, hopscotch): prefill p50 72ms, p95 210ms, decode tokens/sec 11.2k, $/1M tokens ~$3.8
- EU (h100, q8_0, hopscotch): prefill p50 95ms, p95 540ms (!), decode 10.9k, $/1M tokens ~$4.1
- ASIA (h100, q4_0, hopscotch): prefill p50 88ms, p95 260ms, decode 13.5k, $/1M tokens ~$3.1
chen: EU p95 540ms is a big red flag. local thermal/redispatch maybe?
sasha: did hopscotch fall back to generic kernels in EU for some batches?
maya: yes — logs show repeated kernel-fallback events when sequence length > 1024. snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T11:05:12Z] kernel_select: attempted hopscotch q8_0 -> unsupported for seq=1536 -> fallback to generic_fast_attention
[2026-03-20T11:05:12Z] runtime: kvcache miss-rate spike 0.18
```
liam: that fallback explains the p95 spikes. why only EU H100 though?
maya: infra telemetry from the same H100 SKU in eu-west shows occasional power cap throttles correlated with autoscaler churn on the node pool.
infra-bot: notice: node pool eu-west-1b experienced GPU powercap event 2026-03-20T11:04:50 -> 11:06:00
chen: powercap -> performance cliff -> kernel selection heuristic triggers fallback. interesting interplay.
sasha: any quality regressions with q4_0 vs q8_0 on orca-mini?
maya: minimal for typical prompts. q4_0 small hallucination uptick on long-context synth set (0.8% -> 1.7%), but latency gains are meaningful in ASIA.
liam: what's the recommended follow-up? rollback hopscotch in EU? tune kernel selector?
maya: I'm proposing:
1) short: pin hopscotch-ignore-fallback policy in eu-west (reject fallback) so we can measure hard failure vs fallback cost.
2) medium: add kernel selector check to consider powercap flags (avoid hopscotch when powercap active)
3) long: update hopscotch to support seq>1024 codepath (engineering item)
chen: agree. also run a narrow microbench with constant seq=1536 to reproduce and measure tokens/sec delta.
maya: run command I used:
```
./tools/run_regional_bench.sh --model orca-mini-7b --quant q8_0 --kernel hopscotch --regions eu-west1,us-east1,asia-east1 --seqs 128,512,1536 --concurrency 8 --out /tmp/orca_hopscotch.json
```
liam: can you drop the raw /tmp JSON here when you have it?
maya: uploading now. main takeaway: for stable p95s in eu-west, right now A100 looks cheaper per 1M tokens if you need stability; H100 gives peak throughput but risk of fallback spikes.
sasha: noted for the onboarding doc. we'll add a caveat about kernel fallbacks + node powercap interactions.
bench-bot: benchmark upload complete: /bench/3860012345/orca-mini-hopscotch-20260320.json
maya: thanks. next step: infra to add a short-term node annotation we can query in kernel selector (pinging @infra).
